title: Avoid COUNT DISTINCT projection name display allocation
description: Replace count_distinct_projection COUNT detection via func.name.to_string().eq_ignore_ascii_case with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: COUNT DISTINCT projection detection no longer builds a display string for the function name
COUNT DISTINCT behavior remains unchanged for bare and group-by fast paths

notes: count_distinct_projection now reuses the direct ObjectNamePart helper.
